statement: Nvidia will guarantee SB Energy's PORTS-Pike campus in Ohio to exclusively host Nvidia AI compute, with an initial 4.25 IT-GW deployment and an optional 3.75 IT-GW expansion for 8 IT-GW total.
why: An exclusivity guarantee over multi-gigawatt capacity locks a very large future compute site to Nvidia hardware.

impact.mechanism: Exclusive hosting of Nvidia AI compute at an 8 IT-GW campus converts planned power and shell into a committed pipeline for Nvidia systems.

evidence.excerpt: initial deployment of 4.25 IT-GW (information technology gigawatts), with an optional expansion of 3.75 IT-GW, for a total planned capacity of 8 IT-GW

confidence.basis: Nvidia's own newsroom announcement (primary company statement) with explicit capacity figures.
